subject: Shared home-office layouts
hook: Home offices built for two people, not one.
gbp:
Two people working from home in one room? SUPERIO designs and builds fitted home office furniture for households in Stone and across Staffordshire, made to the exact size of your space.

A shared office works best when each person has their own workstation: their own drawers, their own cable route to power, and enough desk width to spread out. We plan side-by-side or back-to-back layouts around your room, your windows and who spends the most time on calls, then add shared shelving for the printer, paper and files.

What's included: a free, no-obligation design consultation; a full measure and an itemised quote with transparent pricing; manufacture in our own workshop in Hanley, quality-checked before it leaves; and delivery and installation by our own team. Finishes include matt white, oak-effect, charcoal and matt black, with soft-close drawers as standard.

Book a free design consultation to plan your shared office.
